description: Recent Truths — same post mapper as /post (links, card, reblog/quote, mentions). 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass the nextCursor value returned in the previous response.

limit.description: Max posts to return (default 20, max 80). Truth Social's statuses page is ~20 items — a full page returns nextCursor. On the extended path hasMore can be true with nextCursor null (truncatedReason=single_page_only). Flat 2 credits.

url.description: Truth Social profile URL or @username. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: truth_social_user_posts
